questions.question: If AB = QR, BC = PR and CA = PQ, then
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AB = QR, BC = PR and CA = PQ

**Formula used:**

Side-side-side congruence rule:- If all the three sides of a triangle are equal to the corresponding sides of another triangle, then the two triangles are congruent to each other.

**Calculation:**

Let ABC and PQR be two triangles.

The congruence of the two triangles is written with respect to the corresponding sides and since AB = QR, BC = PR and CA = PQ, ΔCBA ≅ ΔPRQ.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecc121308bf21ca120cedd954124d2b7f34bd6ddb91b22bf1d356ba87cbb15d8.png] 

**∴ If AB = QR, BC = PR and CA = PQ, then ΔCBA ≅ ΔPRQ.**

questions.question: In a decade, a town's population grew from 1,75,000 to 2,62,500. What is the average annual percentage increase in population?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In a decade, a town's population grew from 1,75,000 to 2,62,500.

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = frac{ {present value - old value}}{ {old value}}

Average = frac{ {sum of all observations}}{ {total number of observations}}

**Calculation:**

Percentage increase in a decade = (262500-175000)/(175000)times 100=(87500)/(1750)=50\% 

Annual average = (50)/(10)=5\%

**∴ The average annual percentage increase in population is 5%.**

questions.question: A train covers the distance between two stations X and Y in 6 hours. If the speed of the train is reduced by 13 km/h, then it travels the same distance in 9 hours. Find the distance between the two stations
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A train covers the distance between two stations X and Y in 6 hours. If the speed of the train is reduced by 13 km/h, then it travels the same distance in 9 hours.

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time taken

**Calculation:**

Let the distance between the station X and Y be d and the initial speed of the train be v

Then, d = 6v

When the speed of the train is reduced by 13km/h, the equation can be written as d = 9(v-13).

Substituting v=(d)/(6) in the above equation and solving for d,

d=9( (d)/(6) -13)

d=(3d)/(2) -117

d = 234km

**∴ The distance between the two stations is 234 km.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Let the initial speed be x

Distance = Speed × Time 

According to the question,

⇒ x × 6 = (x - 13) × 9

⇒ 6x = 9x - 117

⇒ 3x = 117

⇒ x = 39 kmph

Distance = 39 × 6 = 234 km. 

∴ The distance between the two stations is 234 km.

questions.question: Anil offers his customer a discount of 15% on a T-shirt and he still makes a profit of 25%. What is the actual cost of the T-shirt marked ₹500?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs. 500

Discount = 15%

Profit = 25%

**Formula used:**

Selling price = frac{100- {discount}}{100}times{marked price}

;Selling price = frac{100+ {profit}}{100}times{cost price}

**Calculation:**

Selling price = (100-15)/(100)×500=425

Cost price = selling price × (100)/(100+{profit)} 

Cost price = 425times(100)/(100+25)=340

**∴ The actual cost of the T-shirt is Rs. 340.**

questions.question: A family consists of two grandparents, two parents and four grandchildren. The average age of the grandparents is 67 years, that of the parents is 35 years and that of the grandchildren is 9 years. What is the average age of the family?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average age of the grandparents is 67 years, that of the parents is 35 years and that of the grandchildren is 9 years.

**Formula used:**

Sum of the observations = average × no. of observations 

**Calculation:**

The sum of the ages of the grandparents = 67 × 2 = 134 years.

The sum of the ages of the parents = 35 × 2 = 70 years.

The sum of the ages of the grandchildren = 9 × 4 = 36 years.

Sum of the ages of all the 8 family members = 134 + 70 + 36 = 240 years

Average = (240)/(8)=30

**∴ The average age of the family is 30 years.**

questions.question: Find the total surface area of a cuboid whose length is 20 cm, width is 15 cm, and height is 8 cm.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Total Surface Area (TSA)** of a cuboid = 2 × (lw + wh + hl)

TSA = 2 × (20 × 15 + 15 × 8 + 8 × 20)

TSA = 2 × (300 + 120 + 160) = 2 × 580

TSA = 1160 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1160 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Length (l)** = 20 cm, **Width (w)** = 15 cm, **Height (h)** = 8 cm

**Formula:** Total Surface Area = 2(lw + wh + hl)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/438e0f9d31d24575e9ec778cdbca5a76c4cbea6f5279ded50a27cd661f9cc3ac.png] 

⇒ Surface Area of two horizontal faces (Top & Bottom) = 2 × (20 × 15) = 600 cm²

⇒ Surface Area of two vertical side faces (Left & Right) = 2 × (15 × 8) = 240 cm²

⇒ Surface Area of two vertical front/back faces = 2 × (20 × 8) = 320 cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area = 600 + 240 + 320

⇒ Total Surface Area = 1160 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1160 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

The space occupied by a cuboid is given by the product of its three dimensions: Volume = l × w × h.

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The area of the four side walls of the cuboid (excluding top and bottom) is: LSA = 2h(l + w).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The length of the longest rod that can fit inside a cuboid is: d = √(l² + w² + h²).

Surface Area of a Cube

For a cube where l = w = h = a, the Total Surface Area = 6a².</p

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 17 and their product is 34. Find the sum of their squares.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Sum of two numbers is 17

Product of two numbers is 34

**Formula used**

Let x and y be the numbers

(x+y)²=x²+y²+2xy

**Calculation**

x+y=17 

xy=34 

Putting these in the above equation

(x+y)²=x²+y²+2xy 

(17)²=x²+y²+2 times 34

x²+y²=221

**The sum of the squares of the number is 221.**

questions.question: A container is normally filled in 5 hours. However, it takes 6 hours when there is a leak at the bottom. If the container is full, in what time would the leak empty it, if no water is allowed into the container during that period?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Time taken to fill the container normally = 5hr

Time taken to fill when leakage is present = 6hr

**Calculation**

Extra time taken to fill due to leakage = 6 - 5= 1hr

Let the volume of the tank to be V

Part of tank filled in 1hr at normal condition = V/5

Part of tank filled in 1hr in leakage condition = V/6

Part of tank leaked in 1hr = V/5 - V/6 = V/30

So the tank leak 1/30 volume in 1hr

**∴ He full tank is leaked within 30hr.**

questions.question: A beaker contains a mixture of two liquids X and Y in the ratio 5 : 3. When 6 litres of the mixture is drawn off and then replaced with Y, the ratio of X and Y becomes 5 : 7. How many litres of liquid X was contained in the beaker initially?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Two liquids X and Y in the ratio 5 : 3

6 l of the mixture is drawn off and replaced with Y

The final ratio of X and Y = 5 : 7

**CALCULATION:**

Let the beaker initially contains 5z and 3zof mixtures of X and Y respectively,

⇒Quantity of X in mixture left =(5z - 5over8 × 6) = (5z - 15over4 ) L

⇒ Quantity of Y in mixture left = ( 3z - 3over8 × 6) = ( 3z - 9over4 )L

⇒ (5z -(15)/(4))over(3z -(9)/(4)) +6 = (5)/(7) 

⇒ (20z -15)over(12z +15) = 5over7 

⇒ (140z - 60z) = (105 +75) 

⇒ 80z = 180 ⇔ z = 180/80 

⇒ Liters of liquid initially in X = 5z = 5× 180/80 = 11.25

**Hence, initially the liquid in X was 11.25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48f7f38fc54c05892ba476d8b3d97cb871776d0ebb2f174a287048620159158b.png] 

Quantity of X in step 1 and Final will be same.

So, for Y the quantity is increased by 4 unit.

⇒ 4 unit = 6 lt

So 1 unit = (6/4) lt

Then the quantity of X in Step 1 = (6/4) × 5 = 30/4 lt

So, the initial quantity of X = (30/4) + (5/8) of initial mixture drawn

⇒ X = (30/4) + (5/8) × 6

⇒ X = (30/4) + (30/8)

⇒ X = 11.25

Hence, initially the liquid X was 11.25.
